invariants.rationale: The method keyDown returns a boolean, so result must always be either true or false.
The last executed statement in keyDown returns the value of the 'handled' variable.
The method expects event to be non-null for meaningful execution, and it is not checked for null within the method.
Keycodes are typically non-negative integers in keyboard event systems.
If 'disabled' is true, the method returns false immediately.
